name: Client
definition: A bank customer, identified by a unique client identifier (tab03.fld009). A client is connected to accounts only through account-holder (disposition) records; there is no direct client-to-account column.
scope: Customer demographics and account-holder analysis.

name: Client Identifier
definition: Unique numeric identifier of a person (tab03.fld009). It is distinct from the account identifier (tab01.fld001) and from the disposition/account-holder record identifier (tab04.fld006).
scope: Identifying customers in output lists such as 'account holder identification numbers'.

name: Client Gender
definition: Gender of a client, encoded as a single letter: 'F' = female, 'M' = male. No other values occur.
scope: Filtering clients by female/male and computing gender shares.

name: Birth Date
definition: Date of birth of a client, stored as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) ranging from 1911-08-20 to 1987-09-27. An earlier date denotes an older person.
scope: Age ranking, 'oldest' selection, and 'born before' filters.

name: Client Age
definition: Age of a client in years, computed from the birth date. The database contains no age column.
scope: Questions asking for the age of a client.

name: Client District of Residence
definition: The district (okres) in which a client lives, recorded as a district identifier on the client row (tab03.fld002). It references the same 77-value district domain as the district table.
scope: Client-scoped geography such as 'stayed in Sokolov' or district-level counts of clients. Distinct from the account's branch district.

name: Account
definition: A bank account with a unique surrogate identifier, an opening date, a statement-issuance frequency, and one branch location.
scope: Account counts, account-level ownership, and grouping of loans and transactions.

name: Account Identifier
definition: Surrogate numeric identifier of an account (tab01.fld001). The workload phrase 'account number' refers to this identifier; there is no external account-number string in the data.
scope: Returning account numbers or counting distinct accounts.

name: Account Opening Date
definition: Date on which an account was opened (tab01.fld004), stored as an ISO date. Observed openings run from 1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29.
scope: Filters such as 'account opened' or 'opened starting from 1997'.

name: Statement Issuance Frequency
definition: How often statements are issued for an account: monthly ('POPLATEK MESICNE'), weekly ('POPLATEK TYDNE'), or after each transaction ('POPLATEK PO OBRATU').
scope: Selecting accounts by statement issuance behaviour, e.g. 'statement issuance after each transaction'.

name: Branch Location
definition: The district in which an account's branch is located, recorded as a district identifier on the account row (tab01.fld002). Branch identifiers cover all 77 districts and resolve to district rows.
scope: Branch-scoped geography such as 'branch located in south Bohemia' or 'branch location 1'. Distinct from a client's district of residence.

name: Account Holder Record (Disposition)
definition: The link record that attaches a client to an account and states the holder's role. Each account has exactly one OWNER record; additional DISPONENT records may exist.
scope: Reaching clients from accounts, identifying an account's owner, and interpreting 'eligible for loans' as OWNER status.

name: Holder Role
definition: Role of an account holder: 'OWNER' for the primary holder or 'DISPONENT' for an additional authorized holder.
scope: Distinguishing account owners from additional holders.

name: Payment Card
definition: A card issued to an account-holder record. There is exactly one card per card-issuing disposition record and 892 cards in total.
scope: Credit-card questions about card level and cardholders.

name: Card Type
definition: Card product level: 'junior', 'classic' or 'gold'. Gold is the high-level card.
scope: Selecting 'high level credit card' holders.

name: Loan Contract
definition: A loan contract attached to exactly one account; the dataset contains 682 loans on 682 distinct accounts (no account has more than one loan).
scope: Loan status, loan amount and loan-based account selection.

name: Loan Amount
definition: Principal amount of a loan contract, recorded in the loan table (tab06.fld028) and ranging from 4,980 to 590,820.
scope: Averaging or comparing loan amounts. Field tab08.fld028 is a transaction amount with a different meaning.

name: Loan Status
definition: Contract status code. 'C' means a running contract that is OK so far; 'D' means a running contract in debt. 'A' and 'B' are non-running statuses; their precise meaning is not established by the available workload evidence.
scope: Selecting running contracts and contracts in debt.

name: Loan Date
definition: Date on which the loan contract was granted, stored as an ISO date in tab06.fld004; observed from 1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08.
scope: Time filtering of loans.

name: Transaction
definition: A monetary movement on an account. The transaction table holds 1,056,320 rows covering 1993-01-01 to 1998-12-31.
scope: Transaction filtering, aggregation and credit-card withdrawal analysis.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: Monetary amount of a transaction (tab08.fld028). All observed values are non-negative, ranging from 0 to 87,400.
scope: Thresholds such as 'amount less than the average' and amount aggregations.

name: Transaction Type
definition: Coarse debit/credit classification of a transaction: 'PRIJEM' (credit), 'VYDAJ' (debit) or 'VYBER' (withdrawal-type code).
scope: Broad credit/debit filtering.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: Detailed operation code of a transaction: 'VYBER' (cash withdrawal), 'VYBER KARTOU' (credit-card withdrawal), 'VKLAD' (deposit), 'PREVOD NA UCET' (outgoing transfer), 'PREVOD Z UCTU' (incoming transfer), or NULL.
scope: Identifying the specific kind of transaction, including credit-card use.

name: Transaction Date
definition: ISO date on which a transaction occurred (tab08.fld004), covering 1993-01-01 to 1998-12-31.
scope: Year and date filtering of transactions.

name: District
definition: A Czech district (okres), represented by one row in the district table. The 77 districts carry name, region, population, salary, unemployment and crime statistics.
scope: District-level geography and district statistics.

name: District Identifier
definition: Numeric identifier of a district (tab05.fld002), shared as a reference by client residence and account branch attributes. All 77 values are present.
scope: Joining or filtering by a numeric district identifier, e.g. 'branch location 1'.

name: District Name
definition: Human-readable name of a district (tab05.fld012), unique across the 77 rows (e.g. 'Sokolov', 'Ceske Budejovice').
scope: Filtering or listing by district name.

name: Region
definition: A Czech region (kraj) named in tab05.fld013. There are 8 regions, each grouping between 1 and 14 districts.
scope: Region-level geography such as 'south Bohemia'. District statistics remain per district row.

name: District Population
definition: Number of inhabitants of a district, stored as text in tab05.fld014 and ranging from 42,821 to 1,204,953.
scope: Ranking districts or branches by population size.

name: District Average Salary
definition: Average salary statistic of a district (tab05.fld021), an integer between 8,110 and 12,541. It is a district-level measure, not an individual client's salary.
scope: Comparing districts by salary or attaching a salary level to a client through the client's district.

name: Unemployment Rate 1995
definition: District unemployment rate for 1995 stored in tab05.fld022, expressed in percent (observed 0.2 to 7.3).
scope: The earlier-year unemployment measure used for 1995-to-1996 comparisons.

name: Unemployment Rate 1996
definition: District unemployment rate for 1996 stored in tab05.fld023, expressed in percent (observed 0.43 to 9.4).
scope: The later-year unemployment measure used for 1995-to-1996 comparisons.

name: Unemployment Rate Increment
definition: Relative percentage change of district unemployment from 1995 to 1996, computed as (rate_1996 - rate_1995) / rate_1995 * 100. It has no stored column and must be derived.
scope: Questions asking for the percentage increment of unemployment between 1995 and 1996.

name: Crimes Committed 1995
definition: Number of crimes committed in a district during 1995, stored in tab05.fld025 (observed 818 to 85,677). The 1996 counterpart is tab05.fld026.
scope: District-level crime statistics for 1995.

name: Average Salary Gap
definition: Difference between the highest and the lowest district average salary in the compared set. It has no stored column and must be derived from district average salary.
scope: Questions asking for the gap between the lowest and highest average salary.
aliases: gap between lowest and highest average salary

name: Male Client Percentage
definition: Share of male clients within a client group, computed as the count of male clients divided by the count of clients in the group, multiplied by 100.
scope: Questions asking for the percentage of male clients in a branch or other client group.
